s1.title: Download the installer
s1.help: It is a ZIP file made for this server. You download it here and take it to the PC where DCS runs.
s1.what: The installer is a small program that sends this server's data to FOX3. It already includes everything it needs; nothing else has to be installed.
s1.safe1: It only makes outgoing internet connections.
s1.safe2: It needs no open ports on the router or the firewall.
s1.safe3: It needs no Windows administrator rights.

dl.button: Download the installer for this server
dl.code: The file contains a one-time code, valid for {{minutes}} minutes after the download. Do not share it.
dl.started: Download started: {{name}}. Look in your Downloads folder.

nb.title: The installer has not been prepared on this FOX3 server yet.
nb.body: It is not your fault. Whoever installed FOX3 must run this command on the FOX3 server and then click "Check again":

s2.title: Install it on the DCS server PC
s2.help: You only do this once and it takes a couple of minutes.
s2.step1: Copy the ZIP to the PC where DCS runs.
s2.hint1: A USB stick, a shared folder or emailing it to yourself all work. Log in to that PC with the Windows user that runs DCS.
s2.hint2: Right-click the ZIP, choose "Extract all…" and then "Extract". Do not run anything from inside the ZIP.
s2.hint3: It is inside the folder you just unzipped, next to the other files.
s2.step4: If Windows says "Windows protected your PC": click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
s2.hint4: The program is not digitally signed yet, so Windows warns about any new program. This is normal and expected.
s2.step5: Wait until the black window ends with "OK".
s2.hint5: You will see it make progress. Keep it open until it says "OK"; then you can close it.
s2.what1: It pairs the agent with this FOX3 server using the one-time code.
s2.what2: It copies the agent to a folder of your Windows user (it does not touch the system).
s2.what3: It creates a scheduled task for your user so the agent starts by itself when you log in.
s2.what4: It starts the agent and checks that it can reach FOX3. Then it shows up here as "Online".
s2.p1: The code expired (after 15 minutes): download the installer again and repeat.
s2.p2: The PC has no internet or a firewall blocks outgoing traffic: open any web page on that PC to check.
s2.p3: The antivirus blocked the program: allow it (or add an exception for the folder) and run INSTALAR.cmd again.
s2.p4: You installed it with a different Windows user from the one that runs DCS: log in as the DCS user and install again.

s3.title: Waiting for the agent
s3.help: This screen updates by itself every few seconds. You do not need to reload the page.
s3.waiting: Waiting for the agent to connect…
s3.waitingHelp: It takes a few seconds after the black window ends with "OK".
s3.idle: This step starts when you download the installer.
s3.timeoutTitle: More than 3 minutes have passed and the agent has not connected.
s3.timeoutBody: Maybe you have not finished the installation yet, and that is fine: we keep waiting. If you already did, check these common causes:

s4.title: Choose the folders
s4.help: The agent finds the DCS folders by itself. You only have to confirm them.
s4.idle: It will appear here as soon as the agent is connected.
s4.cta: Click the Foothold saves folder and the Tacview folder, then Save.
s4.found: These are the folders the agent detected. Clicking one takes you to its section, where you pick it and save.
s4.none: The agent did not detect any folder. That is fine: go to the sections below and type the path by hand (for example C:\Users\YourUser\Saved Games\DCS\Missions\Saves), then click Save.

guide.title: Full guide for administrators
guide.intro: A summary of the whole process, written for people who run the squad without owning the server.
guide.g1: A small program that runs on the DCS server PC, reads the Foothold and Tacview folders and sends the data to FOX3 over the internet. It only makes outgoing connections: it opens no ports and needs no administrator rights.
guide.g2: You need access to the PC where DCS runs (with the Windows user that runs it) and that PC needs internet. If this page says the installer is not prepared, tell whoever installed FOX3.
guide.g3: Download the installer, copy it to the DCS PC, unzip it and double-click INSTALAR.cmd. If Windows warns you, click "More info" and "Run anyway". Wait until the window ends with "OK". The code in the file is single-use and expires after 15 minutes.
guide.g4: Within seconds the server will turn "Online" and you will see the agent version. If it does not within 3 minutes, check: expired code, no internet, antivirus or a different Windows user.
guide.g5: Once the agent connects, click the Foothold saves folder and the Tacview folder it detected and save each section. If it detected none, type the path by hand.
guide.g6t: 6. Moving to another PC or removing an agent
guide.g6: To move the agent to another PC, download the installer again and install it there; the old agent keeps working until you revoke it in the "Agents of this server" list. A revoked agent stops sending data.

FOOTHOLD_FILE_STALE.title: The Foothold file is not being updated
FOOTHOLD_FILE_STALE.fix: Check that the Foothold mission is still running and saving progress. If the server is stopped, this is normal.

FOOTHOLD_FOLDER_MISSING.title: The Foothold saves folder does not exist
FOOTHOLD_FOLDER_MISSING.fix: Check the path in the Foothold section. You can click one of the folders detected on the server.

FOOTHOLD_FILE_MISSING.title: The Foothold progress file was not found
FOOTHOLD_FILE_MISSING.fix: The folder exists but has no save file in it. Start a Foothold mission so it gets created, or check that the folder is the right one.

FOOTHOLD_FILE_UNREADABLE.title: The Foothold file cannot be read
FOOTHOLD_FILE_UNREADABLE.fix: Check the folder permissions and that no other program has the file locked.

FOOTHOLD_FILE_INVALID.title: The Foothold file has an unexpected format
FOOTHOLD_FILE_INVALID.fix: It may be half-written or damaged. Wait for the next save; if it persists, check your Foothold version.

FOOTHOLD_FOLDER_NOT_SET.title: The Foothold saves folder is not set
FOOTHOLD_FOLDER_NOT_SET.fix: Enter the folder in the Foothold section (or click one of the detected ones) and save.

DCSBOT_UNREACHABLE.title: Cannot reach the DCSServerBot API
DCSBOT_UNREACHABLE.fix: Check that DCSServerBot is running and that the URL and prefix in the DCSServerBot section are correct.

DCSBOT_AUTH_FAILED.title: DCSServerBot rejected the API key
DCSBOT_AUTH_FAILED.fix: The key is set on the server PC, not here. Check it in the agent's local configuration (docs/FASE2-PROVES-REALS.md).

DCSBOT_SERVER_NOT_FOUND.title: DCSServerBot does not know that server name
DCSBOT_SERVER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Type the server name exactly as it appears in DCSServerBot, including capitals and spaces.

DCSBOT_DB_ERROR.title: Error reading the DCSServerBot database
DCSBOT_DB_ERROR.fix: The database password is set on the server PC. Check that PostgreSQL is running and that the agent's local credentials are correct.

DCSBOT_UCID_UNRESOLVED.title: Some pilot could not be identified
DCSBOT_UCID_UNRESOLVED.fix: DCSServerBot did not return the identifier (UCID) of a player. This usually fixes itself; if it persists, check your DCSServerBot version.

DCSBOT_CONFIG_INVALID.title: The DCSServerBot settings are not valid
DCSBOT_CONFIG_INVALID.fix: Review the DCSServerBot section: URL, prefix and server name.

TACVIEW_FOLDER_MISSING.title: The Tacview folder does not exist
TACVIEW_FOLDER_MISSING.fix: Check the path in the Tacview section. You can click one of the folders detected on the server.

TACVIEW_FOLDER_UNREADABLE.title: The Tacview folder cannot be read
TACVIEW_FOLDER_UNREADABLE.fix: Check the folder permissions for the user running the agent.

TACVIEW_FILE_FAILED.title: A Tacview recording could not be read
TACVIEW_FILE_FAILED.fix: That recording is skipped and the rest keep working. It may be damaged or still open in DCS.

TACVIEW_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.title: Unsupported Tacview format
TACVIEW_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Some recordings use a format FOX3 does not understand yet and are skipped. Use standard .acmi or .zip.acmi recordings.

TACVIEW_INDEXING.title: Indexing Tacview recordings
TACVIEW_INDEXING.fix: This is normal after enabling Tacview: search will be complete in a few minutes. Nothing to do.

TACVIEW_APPEARANCES_CAPPED.title: A recording's appearances were capped
TACVIEW_APPEARANCES_CAPPED.fix: One recording has so many pilots that only the first appearances are stored, so some searches may not show everything.

SOURCE_CRASHED.title: An agent module stopped
SOURCE_CRASHED.fix: Restart the agent on the server PC. If it happens again, copy the technical message and tell the developer.

CENTRAL_REJECTED_MESSAGES.title: FOX3 rejected messages from the agent
CENTRAL_REJECTED_MESSAGES.fix: This usually means the agent and FOX3 are on different versions. Update the agent on the server PC.

radios.empty: This draft has no radio data.

ah64.hfModulationHint: Raw code. Its meaning is unverified, so it is shown as a number.
